Return JSON only in this format:
{
  "Subject": "",
  "EmailDraft": "",
  "WhatsAppDraft": ""
}

Lead Details:
Name: {{ $json.Name }}
Email: {{ $json.Email }}
Message: {{ $json.Message }}

Instructions:
- Personalize the response using the lead's name.
- Acknowledge the lead's message.
- Invite the lead to discuss Dubai real estate investment opportunities.
- Keep the email professional and friendly.
- Keep the WhatsApp message under 80 words.
- Return only valid JSON.

parameters.content:
## 1. LEAD SOURCES
WordPress Forms, Facebook Leads, Bayut, Property Finder, Manual (Backend Form) all POST to the Webhook Trigger below.

## 5-7. AI CLASSIFICATION, SCORING & DRAFT (OpenAI / GPT)
Classify & score the lead, save AI data to Sheets, then generate personalised Email + WhatsApp drafts with brochure/project suggestions.

## 11-13. COMMUNICATION, UPDATE & POWER BI
Send approved Email (Brevo) + WhatsApp, track delivery, mark lead Contacted in Sheets, and push data to Power BI. (18. KPI & Analytics dashboards are built in Power BI on this data.)

## 14. FOLLOW-UP AUTOMATION
Wait until follow-up date, check response. If replied → mark Interested/Meeting. If not → reminder Email + WhatsApp, create call task, notify sales, repeat until response or stop.

## 15-19. ERROR HANDLING, LOGGING, ASSIGNMENT, ANALYTICS & BENEFITS
- 15. Error handling is a separate Error Workflow (Lead Management — Error Handler): retries 3x, logs errors, notifies admin.
- 16. Logging & Audit trail -> Logs sheet.
- 17. Lead Assignment (optional) -> Assign Lead node (area/budget/language/workload).
- 18. KPI & Analytics -> Power BI dashboards.
- 19. Benefits: 100% automated, AI classification, real-time notifications, multi-channel, accurate CRM data, scalable & reliable.
